programs.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programs.desc: After years of being sheltered from the human world, the Turtle brothers set out to win the hearts of New Yorkers and be accepted as normal teenagers. Their new friend, April O'Neil, helps them take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.

programs.title: Transplant
programs.desc: Recovering from a personal crisis, Mags worries about how to get her life back on track; Bash takes an unorthodox approach to treating a soldier with PTSD; Theo treats a terminally ill child whose father is desperate for a drug trial.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Davis tries to get Brent to join his rugby team; Brent's more focused on inventing a new rugby chant; Hank and Karen convince Lacey to start selling pizza in the Ruby.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: The band Thunderface reunites; a song Brent wrote back in high school has Lacey investigating his mystery crush; Oscar shoots a fundraising video for the Seniors' Center.

programs.title: Law & Order
programs.desc: Frantic parents urge detectives to find their missing 24-year-old daughter, who worked as an aide to a state senator.

programs.title: Alien: Romulus
programs.desc: Space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life-form in the universe while scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station.

programs.title: Love Island
programs.desc: Ariana Madix hosts a recoupling where Islanders write emotional letters to the person they want to couple up with; while some discover their feelings are mutual, others are left staring into an empty mailbox as the villa's new couples are revealed.

programs.title: Fast X
programs.desc: Over many missions and against impossible odds, Dom Toretto and his family have outsmarted and outdriven every foe in their path. Now, they must confront the most lethal opponent they've ever faced. Fueled by revenge, a terrifying threat emerges from the shadows of the past to shatter Dom's world and destroy everything -- and everyone -- he loves.

programs.title: Ferrari
programs.desc: During the summer of 1957, bankruptcy looms over the company that Enzo Ferrari and his wife built 10 years earlier. He decides to roll the dice and wager it all on the iconic Mille Miglia, a treacherous 1,000-mile race across Italy.

programs.title: The Pitt
programs.desc: After a motorcycle collision, a husband and wife are rushed to the ER; as King and Javadi deal with a bickering family, Santos is forced to check her assumptions about a possible case of child abuse; Robby bonds with a Tree of Life survivor.

programs.title: The Amazing Maurice
programs.desc: Maurice is a streetwise ginger cat who comes up with a money-making scam by befriending a group of talking rats. However, when Maurice and the rodents reach the town of Bad Blintz, their little con soon goes down the drain.

programs.title: Amish Affair
programs.desc: Hannah knows her secret relationship with Aaron, a charismatic Amish leader, has them both living in sin, so she decides to end it. However, when Aaron's wife suspiciously dies, she finds herself framed for murder and fighting to prove her innocence.
